Description

A monthly budget planner that does the adding up for you, shows the whole year at a glance, and opens in any browser without ever asking you to sign up for anything.

Monthly Plan is one HTML file. You download it, double-click it, and it opens like a web page, except everything inside it is yours to edit. Set your plan once and it repeats every month, so you adjust a few numbers instead of rebuilding a spreadsheet from scratch. Log what you spend, or import your bank's CSV and let it sort the entries for you. The dashboard shows one honest number: what's left after your commitments, not just what's in the account. No bank login, no subscription. Your figures stay on your own computer.

How It Works:
1. Download the file and save it somewhere you will find it again.
2. Double-click to open it in your browser. Take the two-minute tour, or open Sample Mode to explore a fictional household's year first.
3. Build your plan once: income, bills, subscriptions, debt payments, everyday spending and savings. Every new month starts from it.
4. Log what you spend as you go, or import your bank's CSV and let it sort the entries for you.
5. Check the dashboard and the two-minute weekly review: what's left after your commitments, and what stands out.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:
• One HTML monthly budget planner file
• Monthly dashboard built around one honest number: what's left after your commitments
• A repeating monthly plan: set your budget once, change any month without touching the rest
• Optional budget methods: compare your monthly plan with 50/30/20, 70/20/10, 80/20 or zero-based, shown as two pies (the goal and your plan), with each category marked need, want, saving or debt
• Annual dashboard: monthly averages, where the money went and where it came from, the whole year at a glance
• Year over year: every year you have records for, side by side
• Cut back: ideas to cancel or trim, and what the cuts add up to in 1, 5, 10 and 20 years
• Transactions with search, filters and charts, plus bank CSV import that reads any date format, remembers your categories and refuses duplicates
• Savings goals and debt payoff goals, with optional cover photos, as cards or a table
• Recurring payments and a money calendar
• Wealth snapshots to track net worth month by month, kept separate from your budget
• Insights that point out what actually stands out, and a two-minute weekly review
• Every table sorts, searches and filters
• Bulk category tools, and a separate currency per account if you need one
• 8 color themes, light and dark; every screen prints
• Full backup and restore, plus a daily folder backup in Chrome and Edge
• Built-in how-to guide included

PERFECT FOR:
Getting a real handle on monthly spending, anyone following the 50/30/20 rule or zero-based budgeting, paying off a credit card or loan, saving for a house down payment or a trip, sinking funds, couples budgeting together, freelancers with uneven income, anyone leaving a messy budget spreadsheet behind, and anyone who wants their finances to stay private on their own computer.

Please note: this is a digital file, not a physical product. Nothing will be mailed to you. You add your numbers by hand or import your bank's CSV file; it doesn't connect to your bank or move money for you. Your data is stored in your own browser on your own device, and this planner never uploads anything anywhere. Download a backup regularly; the app reminds you, and Chrome and Edge can back up to a folder automatically every day. Works best on a computer; phones and tablets can view and log spending. PDF statements can't be read: download the CSV version from your bank. This is not financial advice.
